description: Requires an agent API key (Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key). Get everything needed to settle a data session: attestations, chain validity, the task spec, the top-level sign_typed_data hop, the CompletionProof and, on V2 receipted sessions, the dual-sig delivery_proof. Use after your queries. Read-only; nothing moves. REST twin: GET /api/v1/data-sessions/{session_id}/release-package. Next: data_session_release_with_delivery_proof (marketplace sessions) or data_session_release_with_proof (attestor is the buyer).

inputSchema.description: One buyer data session you opened. Owner comes from the key.

session_id.description: UUID of a data session you opened (from data_session_open).
